summary: Accept fractal.v1 peer response envelope labels alongside st3.v1

schema.detail: The registry name, digest and database schema are unchanged.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules, signature domains or fleet coordination changes.

compatibility.detail: Peer readers accept fractal.v1 response envelopes as well as the permanent st3.v1 read spelling. Writers continue emitting st3.v1; unknown versions remain unsupported. Secrets and Discord transport readers already accept both labels.

downtime.detail: This additive reader change requires no coordinated interruption.

recovery.detail: Writers remain unchanged, so older readers can still consume emitted envelopes after rollback.
